fields.name: total_liquidity
docs: LP-owned liquidity units. One share is one liquidity unit, so shares == total_liquidity.

fields.name: borrowed
docs: Liquidity currently removed from Orca by borrowers.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Liquidity reserved by pending opens (counts toward utilization immediately).

fields.name: withdrawal_requested
docs: Liquidity with a pending LP withdrawal request (cannot be newly borrowed).

fields.name: withdrawal_notice_start
docs: Earliest unfulfilled withdrawal request time (0 if none); starts the notice period.

fields.name: fee_index_base_x64
docs: Idle Orca fees per share (Q64.64), by token, with exact carried remainders.

fields.name: open_legs
docs: Number of executed, unrestored borrowed legs on this bucket.

fields.name: checkpoint_ts
docs: Timestamp and count of leg checkpoints in the current second. A share change is only
allowed when every open leg checkpointed in the same transaction (section 4.3).

types.name: Config
docs: Global configuration. Set once by the program upgrade authority, which names a separate
market-registry admin key (section 5).

fields.name: removed_base
docs: Exact token amounts removed from Orca at open (the leg's principal escrow).

fields.name: escrow_base
docs: Remaining leg ledgers in escrow (principal + buffer), by mint.

fields.name: buffer
docs: Restoration buffer funded by the user, in the removed mint.

fields.name: premium_distributed
docs: Premium already transferred to the bucket's LP index.

fields.name: provided_base
docs: Provided legs: tokens the user funded, tokens returned at close, and actual Orca fees
the position collected (fee credits, never projected fees).

fields.name: extra_buffer
docs: Restoration buffer above the market minimum, in the removed mint.

types.name: LpDeposit
docs: A staged ladder deposit of an existing Orca position (section 4.2). The original position's
liquidity is withdrawn into this ticket's escrow and redeployed bucket by bucket; it is not
advertised as active until every bucket is funded.

fields.name: cursor
docs: Next bucket (by index from tick_lower) to redeploy.

fields.name: bucket_width
docs: Bucket width in ticks (a multiple of the tick spacing), grid anchored at tick 0.

fields.name: fee_vault_base
docs: Idle-liquidity Orca fees collected for LPs, by token.

types.name: MarketParams
docs: Per-market economic and safety parameters (section 8.6). Snapshotted into each strategy
where they affect its terms; admin changes apply to new positions only.

fields.name: base_account
docs: PythPair: base/USD PriceUpdateV2 account. ForkScenario: ScenarioReference account.

fields.name: quote_account
docs: PythPair: quote/USD PriceUpdateV2 account. ForkScenario: unused.

fields.name: price_x64
docs: Quote atoms per base atom, Q64.64.

fields.name: cap_binding
docs: Set when accrued premium reaches the LP cap; the remaining cap is then allocated pro
rata over unpaid leg premiums at final settlement.

fields.name: recovery_recorded
docs: Counted in market.unresolved_strategies while true.

fields.name: fee_credit_base
docs: Fee credits from provided legs (actual collected fees), netted against premium in the UI
and returned to the owner at settlement; never used to raise authorized spending.

fields.name: close_started_at
docs: When the close (or abort) was authorized; a close stalled longer than the market's
pending deadline may be flagged as Recovery by anyone.

fields.name: legs
docs: Heap-allocated on deserialization (a fixed array would overflow the 4 KB SBF frame).
